observed_root_causes.finding: Approval actions were children of transcript VStack. User-input requests alone used the dedicated safe-area bottom bar.
Prior tests scrolled until controls were hittable, validating actions while concealing wrong attachment. No stationary-card assertion existed for approval.
Task-row implementation is carried by an independent host-grouped fixture and generic modal NavigationStack. It lacks the official project hierarchy, source chips and page composer.
Partial parent/geometry states were recorded but subsequent delivery continued at leaf-component granularity without closing the full page.

official_observations.conclusion: Approval background has rounded rectangle24, bg/primary opacity0.82, regular Material, border/default width0.5 and black0.12 shadow radius18/x0/y8. It differs from the question-card Glass style.
Banner stack spacing16; inner top12/horizontal20/bottom20; outer card horizontal20/top4/bottom8. Effective wide-screen maxWidth is environment-owned and unresolved.
Optional horizontal command preview and native approval-card composition exist. Full parent branch selection and reason/command formatting remain partial.

missing: full user-message and assistant action presentation

changes: Move scoped approval actions out of transcript into the existing bottom bar
Show explicit synthetic reason and command preview
Add stationary-card regression with real transcript movement and cross-host cleanup

Bottom attachment is corroborated by supplied UI and native composition; full branch producer remains partial
Reason and command are explicit synthetic presentation inputs; their full official formatting is pending
